key: FLORINIA: Meteor Headquarters confirmed beyond gate.
en: FLORINIA: Meteor Headquarters confirmed beyond gate.
ja: フロリニア: メテオ本部が、この門の先にあることを確認した。

key: JULIA: Now it's just a matter of opening it!
en: JULIA: Now it's just a matter of opening it!
ja: ジュリア: あとは開けるだけだね!

key: I can easily blow this gate to smithereens, but I used the last of my boomies getting in.
en: I can easily blow this gate to smithereens, but I used the last of my boomies getting in.
ja: この門くらい簡単に粉々にできるけど、入る時にドッカーンを使い切っちゃったんだよね。

key: But if they were planning to do demolitions, they probably have some that they'd let us borrow!
en: But if they were planning to do demolitions, they probably have some that they'd let us borrow!
ja: でも、あいつらが解体作業を計画してたなら、たぶん貸してもらえるようなのを持ってるはずだよ!

key: If we can get those, I can get us past here no problem-o!
en: If we can get those, I can get us past here no problem-o!
ja: それさえ手に入れば、ここを通るのなんて楽勝だよ!

key: FLORINIA: Regardless...
en: FLORINIA: Regardless...
ja: フロリニア: いずれにせよ……

key: FLORINIA: This facility's digital security system appears substandard.
en: FLORINIA: This facility's digital security system appears substandard.
ja: フロリニア: この施設のデジタルセキュリティシステムは、水準以下と見受けられる。

key: A brute force attack should be sufficient. Please hold.
en: A brute force attack should be sufficient. Please hold.
ja: ブルートフォース攻撃で十分だろう。しばし待たれよ。

key: JULIA: Brute force? I don't think we're gonna punch through the door!
en: JULIA: Brute force? I don't think we're gonna punch through the door!
ja: ジュリア: ブルートフォース? それドア殴っても開かないと思うよ!

key: \PN, think you can find where they keep the explosives? It wasn't the way we came, but it's probably nearby!
en: \PN, think you can find where they keep the explosives? It wasn't the way we came, but it's probably nearby!
ja: \PN、爆発物がどこにあるか見つけられそう? 来た道じゃないけど、たぶん近くにあるはず!

key: If you can do that, we'll be in easily!
en: If you can do that, we'll be in easily!
ja: それができれば、簡単に入れるようになるから!

key: FLORINIA: Why is combustion your solution to any obstacle?
en: FLORINIA: Why is combustion your solution to any obstacle?
ja: フロリニア: なぜお前は、あらゆる障害への解決策が燃焼なのだ?

key: JULIA: Fun for the whole family?
en: JULIA: Fun for the whole family?
ja: ジュリア: 家族みんなで楽しめるから?

key: FLORINIA: Indeed.
en: FLORINIA: Indeed.
ja: フロリニア: なるほど。

key: FERN: Whatever, man, I don't have time to sit around all day and wait for the Flobot to hack into the system. Let's just go find some bombs already.
en: FERN: Whatever, man, I don't have time to sit around all day and wait for the Flobot to hack into the system. Let's just go find some bombs already.
ja: ファーン: ま、いいわ。フロボットがシステムをハッキングするの、一日中待ってる時間はねえからな。さっさと爆弾を探しに行こうぜ。

key: JULIA: That's the spirit! For once Fern says something I agree with!
en: JULIA: That's the spirit! For once Fern says something I agree with!
ja: ジュリア: その意気だよ! ファーンの言うことに賛成するの、珍しいな!

key: Quick, \PN! To the boom-mobile!
en: Quick, \PN! To the boom-mobile!
ja: 急いで、\PN! ドッカーンモービルへ!

key: JULIA: They were planning on kabooming my Gym, so they must have explosives here somewhere. Let's find them!
en: JULIA: They were planning on kabooming my Gym, so they must have explosives here somewhere.  Let's find them!
ja: ジュリア: アタシのジムをドッカーンする計画だったんだから、どこかに爆発物があるはずだよ。探そう!

key: FERN: Here you go, crazy lady.
en: FERN: Here you go, crazy lady.
ja: ファーン: ほら、イカれた姉ちゃん。

key: JULIA: Boomies! You got them!
en: JULIA: Boomies! You got them!
ja: ジュリア: ドッカーン! 取ってきてくれたんだ!

key: Okay, let's do this!
en: Okay, let's do this!
ja: よし、やるよ!

key: JULIA: Okay! Three... Two... Ka...
en: JULIA: Okay! Three... Two... Ka...
ja: ジュリア: よーし! さーん……にー……カ……

key: ...Huh?
en: ...Huh?

key: FLORINIA: Access granted. Let us proceed.
en: FLORINIA: Access granted. Let us proceed.
ja: フロリニア: アクセス許可。進行しよう。

key: JULIA: Wait, but...
en: JULIA: Wait, but...
ja: ジュリア: ちょっと、でも……

key: I-- And...
en: I-- And...
ja: アタシ――それに……

key: The booms!
en: The booms!
ja: ドッカーンが!

key: What about the booms?!
en: What about the booms?!
ja: ドッカーンはどこ行ったの!?

key: Rini! You can't do that!
en: Rini! You can't do that!
ja: リニ! そんなのアリじゃないよ!

key: I was just about to-- Rini!!!
en: I was just about to-- Rini!!!
ja: ちょうどこれから――リニ!!!

key: FERN: Hah, leave it to my sister to ruin everyone's fun.
en: FERN: Hah, leave it to my sister to ruin everyone's fun.
ja: ファーン: はっ、うちの姉貴に任せりゃ、みんなの楽しみは台無しになるってもんだ。

key: Whatever, let's just get a move on it.
en: Whatever, let's just get a move on it.
ja: ま、いいから動くぞ。

key: It does take time to encode the necessary anti-security program.
en: It does take time to encode the necessary anti-security program.
ja: 必要な対セキュリティプログラムを組むのには、時間がかかるものだ。

key: One moment, please.
en: One moment, please.
ja: しばしお待ちを。
